_note: The deployed perception build, as a checkable artefact. A procedure onboards with ZERO retraining exactly when everything it requires is listed here. Adding a class, a state, a motion class or a capability is a model release (new data, new weights, new version) - never a procedure edit. procedures name this file through requires.min_model_version.
_state_heads_note: What each detector class's state classifier can actually emit. A procedure asking state_is(latch, half_open) needs a retrained state head just as surely as a new object needs a retrained detector, so state vocabularies are part of the build, not of the procedure.
_position_sigma_note: Per-axis centroid noise, measured on the held-out calibration set (PLAN.md W5). Null until measured - an invented value is worse than none.
